measurement: Accepted card casts per completed simulation match, not individual spawned bodies

live_reference.measurement: card casts confirmed by fresh own-hand rotation, not spawned body count
live_reference.body_count_note: Unique entity ID/address within each completed match window. Short-lived bodies can be missed between snapshots; observed bodies are a lower bound, separate from confirmed card casts.

live_note: Only the original joint economy_soft has completed live matches in this comparison; no live results are imputed to other models.
